components.css: .ds-desk { font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 20px 24px 22px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #E8DBC9, #DFCDB6); border-radius: 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tag { position: relative; width: 200px; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 10px 10px 10px 30px; padding: 13px 14px 12px 38px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(60,44,28,.10), 0 8px 18px -10px rgba(60,44,28,.45); } .ds-tag::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 50%; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: -6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #DFCDB6; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.28); } .ds-tag .lb { display: block; font-stretch: 78%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #676C71; } .ds-tag .v { display: block; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin: 3px 0 4px; color: #C42F35; } .ds-tag .s { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #676C71; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; font-stretch: 75%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 5px; line-height: 16px; transform: rotate(-2deg); color: #C42F35; }

narrative.overview:
The page is the reception desk of a co-living house. A charcoal header carries the THRIVE wordmark; one oak desk band holds the verdict sentence and five enamel key tags, each with a rubber status stamp; the latest weeks hang as tags on a key rack; everything else is the register: white cards with hairline borders on a warm grey ground. The world lives in a few objects (tag, stamp, rack, building, keycard). The rest stays quiet so the numbers carry the page.

Density is moderate and type is deliberately modest: the largest figure on the page is 24px. One family, Archivo, does every job by changing its width: condensed for stamps and labels, normal for reading, expanded for the wordmark. Figures are always tabular.

Rejected by the user and not to return: the v1 bright bento SaaS board, Poppins with serif capitals, oversized titles, emoji, and decoration that carries no meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal header, oak desk band, warm ground, white cards.
Brass marks whatever is live: selection, focus, current week, links, active tab.
Green and red appear only for money in/out, gain/loss and overdrawn state, always paired with a sign, a stamp or a position.
Archivo variable (wdth 62-125, wght 400-800) only, with tabular figures.
Charts drawn to scale on one axis; planned data is dashed or hatched, never a different hue.

rules.name: The Money Pair Rule
rules.body: Green and red mean money in/gain and money out/loss/overdrawn, nothing else. Every use is paired with a sign, a stamp or a position above/below the line, never colour alone.

rules.name: The Brass Is Live Rule
rules.body: If the reader can act on it or it is the current selection, it is brass. Brass is not used for decoration.

rules.name: The Clear Figures Rule
rules.body: Theme material (oak, charcoal, line art, gradients) never sits behind a number. Figures sit on card white or the ground.

rules.name: The Modest Scale Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page exceeds 24px. A larger number earns weight, not size.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo only. Width and weight carry the hierarchy; no second face, no serif, no Poppins.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: All figures use tabular numerals (set on body), so columns of lakh values align.

rules.name: The Only Things That Hang Rule
rules.body: Soft warm drop shadows belong to tags and the keycard. Cards don't lift; no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do set every figure in Archivo with tabular numerals on card white or ground.
Do use brass for focus, selection, current week, active tabs and links.
Do pair green or red with a sign, a stamp or a position above/below the line.
Do show planned data with dashes, hatching or a dashed stamp, in the same hue as actual.
Do draw charts to scale on one axis and give each card a title and one hint line.
Do honour reduced motion: all animation and transition is switched off.
donts: Don't use Poppins, serif capitals or any second family.
Don't set titles or figures above 24px.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons; icons are inline line SVGs.
Don't add decoration that carries no meaning; tags, stamps, the rack, the building and the Charminar each stand for something.
Don't put oak, charcoal, line art or gradients behind numbers.
Don't use green or red for anything except money direction, gain/loss and overdrawn state: not for actual/planned status, success, errors or emphasis.
Don't use the Charminar outside the gate and the footer.
Don't bring back the v1 bento layout or its bright card palette.
